title: Adam's Fall and the Best Clothing

paragraphs.text: Satan swore he was a sincere friend. He tricked them, and they ate from the tree. Their bodies became uncovered. They covered themselves with leaves. They asked their Lord for forgiveness and mercy. Allah sent them down to the earth. They will live and die there.

Allah gave clothing to cover and to beautify. But the clothing of righteousness is best. Children of Adam, do not let Satan trick you. He and his tribe see you, but you cannot see them. Allah does not order shameful deeds. He orders justice.
Dress well at every masjid. Eat and drink, but do not waste. Good things are for believers. Allah forbids sin, wrongdoing and lying about Him. Every nation has a fixed time.
Those who fear Allah will have no fear. Those who deny the verses will be in the Fire. At death, they will witness against themselves.
